descriptions.rgb: The scene is a shallow, rocky river bordered by distant tree-lined hills over 50 metres away, viewed by a camera wearer seated in a light-blue inflatable tube. A narrow rock ledge cuts diagonally through the water 1 to 2 metres in front and to the right, while a blue-and-white floating cooler sits about 2 metres away on the far side of the ledge, partially cut off by the right edge of the frame. In the third frame, the camera tilts upward and turns left toward the open river rapids and hills, moving the wearer's body, tube, and nearby cooler completely below and to the right of the field of view. Across the fourth and fifth frames, the camera tilts slightly back down and turns right, bringing the rock ledge, the floating cooler about 2 metres ahead, and a second person seated in another light-blue tube about 1.5 metres to the right into view. This second person is partly cut off by the right frame edge in the fourth frame before appearing more fully in the fifth frame, positioned about 0.5 to 1 metre right of the cooler—which is within their arm's reach along with their own tube—while facing and looking generally toward the camera wearer and the water between them.
